Dr Richmond Loh, a board-certified fish veterinarian, senior vet pathologist and qualified educator with more than two decades of clinical, diagnostic & mentoring experience; has investigated thousands of fish cases across ornamental, aquaculture, public-aquarium, research and wild-fish settings. This channel shows veterinary medical procedures to educate people on how Veterinarians cure sick fish. If your fish is sick, consult a fish veterinarian. Dr Loh treats and cures sick fish, from a goldfish with bloat, to a cichlid with Hexamita, fish with cloudy eye infections, or parasites like white spot disease, gill flukes, parasitic worms and skin tumor and ulcers.

Are you struggling with fish problems? Online FishVetMasterclass is made for veterinarians, veterinary students and fish-health professionals who want to fast-track their expertise. Learn in months what took me years to master - how a fish specialist thinks and avoid years of trial and error and become the go-to fish expert.
